task_completion.description: Log into the Odoo dashboard using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Odoo home screen or app drawer after the login page, showing the user 'admin' is logged in.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the Time Off application and the Allocations view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Time Off' app open, specifically the 'Allocations' menu item selected under 'Approvals' or 'Management'.

task_completion.description: Open a new allocation creation form.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new, empty or partially filled 'Allocation' form is visible with fields for Employee, Time Off Type, and Duration.

task_completion.description: Set the employee to 'Randall Lewis' and Time Off Type to 'Paid Time Off'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Employee' field contains 'Randall Lewis' and the 'Time Off Type' field contains 'Paid Time Off' in the form.

task_completion.description: Set the duration to 15 days and select the allocation type.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Duration' field shows '15.00' days. Note: Per system constraints, the agent should select 'Regular' or the equivalent UI option for 'Fixed by HR'.
The allocation record status changes from 'Draft' to 'To Approve' or 'Approved' (usually a green badge), and the 'Validate' button is clicked.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements, clicking buttons, and typing into form fields within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the UI rather than jumping directly to a final success URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the sequence of clicking the Time Off app icon and the Create button.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the specific values for Randall Lewis and 15 days.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the dropdown selection or typing of 'Randall Lewis' and '15' into the respective fields.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The employee name must be 'Randall Lewis'. The leave type must be 'Paid Time Off'. The duration must be exactly 15 days. Note: While the task asks for 'Fixed by HR', in Odoo 17.0+, this corresponds to the 'Regular' allocation type (as opposed to 'Accrual'). The allocation is only 'validated' once it moves past the 'Draft' state, typically indicated by a status badge or the 'Validate' button being pressed by the admin.
